description: This file defines a Java interface 'TransactionService' for managing transactions related to payments. It extends a generic service and declares methods for retrieving specific transaction types associated with orders, such as capturable and refundable transactions, as well as listing transactions.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: An interface extending the generic entity service for Transaction entities, providing methods to obtain specific transaction types related to orders.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a previous transaction of type 'authorize' for the specified order, which can be captured.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction associated with the order that is eligible for a refund.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Lists all transactions related to the specified order.
